scope: Pair-by-locus evidence integration for the five preselected Brain6 deep-follow-up pairs. This rule does not create evidence or promote any current partial-family PLACO candidate to a final shared locus.

global_map.significance_source: original locked 396-test atlas q value; no new 72-test correction

lava_family.correction: Benjamini-Hochberg across the complete frozen five-pair by 2,495-locus family

placo_family.interpretation: PLACO is shared-association evidence, not biological pleiotropy or causality

replication_master_at_freeze.use: Source baseline only; use the completed, source-verified replication ledger at tier assignment

prerequisites.lava: Select exactly one complete, identity-verified run for the full 12,475-slot family; never merge baseline and roundoff runs. Require the predeclared maximum failure fraction and a complete family-level BH correction.
prerequisites.placo: All four v3 pairs and protected Track B must have source-verified outputs and complete five-track correction; partial-family outputs cannot assign final tiers.
prerequisites.loci: Use only exact-reference matched candidate variants and the frozen shared_locus_rule_v1 clumping/region-merge procedure. Unmatched variants remain audited but do not define independent loci.
prerequisites.annotation: Do not inspect or use gene, QTL, cell-type, regulatory, or pathway annotations when assigning tiers. Freeze this rule before any such review.

criteria.global_discovery: The linked pair is significant using its inherited q value from the original 396-test atlas family (q < 0.05).
criteria.local_primary: The selected complete LAVA run reports the pair-locus as TESTED and its q value is < 0.05 in the complete 12,475-test BH family.
criteria.local_robust: local_primary passes, and every applicable, predeclared local robustness analysis is complete, direction-concordant, and has no failed or unknown gate; the matrix must include local-h2 threshold, sample-overlap, MHC-exclusion, and HDL-L checks, plus alternate-LD-reference checks where scientifically defensible. Missing or unrun checks do not count as robust.
criteria.shared_variant: At least one lead variant in the frozen nonduplicated locus has P_PLACO < 1e-8, Q_BONFERRONI_ACROSS_PAIRS < 0.05, and an exact chromosome-position match to the locked reference in a complete five-track family.
criteria.independent_replication: A source-verified external estimate for the linked global pair has two-sided P < 0.05, direction concordant with discovery, exact phenotype relation, documented non-overlapping cohorts, and no unresolved participant-level overlap. A directional replication label with unresolved overlap does not satisfy this criterion.
criteria.contradictory_replication: A source-verified eligible external replication is direction-discordant or has two-sided P >= 0.05; such a pair cannot be promoted to TIER_1 or TIER_2.

tiers.TIER_1: global_discovery AND independent_replication AND local_robust AND shared_variant AND NOT contradictory_replication
tiers.TIER_2: global_discovery AND local_robust AND shared_variant AND NOT contradictory_replication, when TIER_1 is not met because fully independent replication is not established
tiers.TIER_3: shared_variant only, or shared_variant with incomplete global/local/replication support; label exploratory and PLACO-only where applicable. Requires complete five-track PLACO evidence and must never be described as robust local sharing or a causal/biological mechanism.
tiers.NOT_TIERED: No qualifying shared_variant evidence, contradictory replication, incomplete prerequisite families, or an ineligible global pair (including Alzheimer NO_ELIGIBLE_PAIR). Preserve missing/unknown states; do not impute a tier.

assignment_policy.missing_evidence: Unknown, unavailable, partial-family, or unrun evidence fails the corresponding positive criterion; do not treat it as negative evidence.
assignment_policy.annotation_firewall: Tier assignment must be completed and hashed before any functional annotation is joined.
assignment_policy.claims: A tier is an evidence summary only. It does not establish a causal variant, causal gene, mediation, or biological pleiotropy.
